clue.text: Not what a cool straight faced poker player would show

definitions.text: Not what a cool straight faced poker player would show

parts.words: Not what a cool straight faced poker player would show
parts.note: a poker player keeping a straight face never reddens; the word for a reddening of the cheeks is also a poker hand ranking above a straight

explanation.surface: A description of the tell an unflappable card player would never give away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Straight' points at poker hands, but the clue really wants the reddening of the face that a cool player avoids, which shares its name with a hand of five cards in one suit.
explanation.definitionFit: A blush of colour in the face is the giveaway an impassive card player suppresses; the same word names a hand of one suit.

clue.text: The object in this puzzle is to articulate your thoughts

definitions.text: The object in this puzzle is
definitions.meaning: solving a crossword means locating the right entries for the grid
putting thoughts into speech means locating the right vocabulary

explanation.surface: A remark that the point of a crossword is to express yourself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is a link between the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Solving a crossword is a hunt for the right vocabulary, and expressing ideas means choosing vocabulary too.

clue.text: Run one in to declare total bankruptcy

parts.note: to declare something is to utter it

indicators.note: in tells us the letter for one goes inside the word run

parts.note: taken as written
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Advice to someone on a losing streak to file for bankruptcy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Run' looks like a losing streak at cards; it is just the word itself, opened up by 'in' to take the one.
explanation.definitionFit: Complete financial collapse is described as absolute ruination.

clue.text: Meet the conqueror of Everest

definitions.meaning: a meet is a gathering of riders and hounds for a chase
John ... led the 1953 British expedition that first climbed Everest

explanation.surface: An invitation to be introduced to a famous mountaineer.
explanation.walkthrough: In British usage a 'meet' is the assembly of a fox chase; Lord Hunt was leader of the 1953 Everest expedition.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering for a fox chase is called a meet, and Lord Hunt led the expedition that first summited Everest.

clue.text: An abrasive beach lover's journal perhaps

definitions.meaning: a gritty sheet for smoothing wood
whimsically, a newspaper for someone fond of the seaside

explanation.surface: A gritty newspaper for sun-worshippers.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word into two parts: the stuff of beaches plus a journal, as in a newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Glasspaper coated with grit is the standard abrasive sheet for smoothing wood.

clue.text: The first bid is the final bet

definitions.meaning: at an auction, the opening figure offered
in horse racing, the odds on offer as the race begins, the last at which bets are settled

explanation.surface: A claim that an opening offer and a closing wager are the same thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is' links the two definitions; the racing sense is the SP, the odds when the race starts.
explanation.definitionFit: An auction's opening figure and the bookmakers' closing odds at a race's off both carry this name.

clue.text: Utter devotion please

definitions.meaning: to speak words of worship to God
an old-fashioned polite request, as in 'be seated, I beg you'

explanation.surface: A plea to express complete devotion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Utter' looks like an adjective meaning total, but it is the verb: to voice devotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Speaking to God in worship is the act of devotion, and the old formula for asking politely uses the same word.

clue.text: Ungodly silver in vessel used for alluvial gold

indicators.note: in places the symbol for silver inside the prospector's vessel

parts.note: prospectors wash river gravel in a pan to find gold
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A heathen prospector panning for gold finds silver.
explanation.definitionFit: A heathen, outside the faith, is irreligious.

clue.text: Mock a large assembly

definitions.meaning: to tease or banter with someone
a mass meeting, often political

explanation.surface: A call to jeer at a big gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic verb for teasing, and a mass meeting of supporters, share the word.

clue.text: Impracticable whichever way it is viewed

indicators.note: the letters read the same forwards and backwards, a palindrome

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Something unworkable from every angle.
explanation.definitionFit: A colloquial phrase for something that cannot be done or is unacceptable.

clue.text: Maybe Michael provides port for the Russians

definitions.meaning: Michael is one of the chief angels in scripture
Arkhangelsk, the White Sea port, in its English spelling

explanation.surface: A man called Michael supplying a harbour to Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'provides' links the two definitions; 'Maybe' marks Michael as one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Michael is a chief angel in scripture, and the White Sea port of Arkhangelsk takes its name from him.

clue.text: Homer bringing news of an odyssey

definitions.text: Homer bringing news of an odyssey

parts.words: Homer bringing news of an odyssey
parts.note: a homer here is a bird that flies home with messages, not the Greek poet of the Odyssey

explanation.surface: The Greek poet recounting tales of Odysseus's wanderings.
explanation.walkthrough: Homer and odyssey conjure the epic poet; 'homer' is a homing bird used to deliver messages.
explanation.definitionFit: A homing bird trained to fly back with messages is a homer.

clue.text: In a way, right to be cautious

indicators.note: In tells us the letter for right goes inside the word way

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Being careful is, in a sense, correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a way' looks like a hedge, but 'In' is the container signal, putting R inside WAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on guard against danger is being careful.

clue.text: Jump to no conclusion

definitions.meaning: to jerk suddenly in surprise
the beginning, the opposite of an ending

explanation.surface: Advice not to leap to judgements.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface echoes 'jump to conclusions'; 'to' only links the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden flinch of surprise, and a beginning rather than an end, both go by this word.

clue.text: Deadly sin even Vyshinsky concealed

indicators.note: concealed tells us the letters lie buried inside the words even Vyshinsky

explanation.surface: Even the Soviet prosecutor Vyshinsky kept one of the seven sins hidden.
explanation.walkthrough: Andrey Vyshinsky was the Soviet prosecutor of Stalin's show trials.
explanation.definitionFit: Jealousy of others' good fortune is one of the seven cardinal sins.

clue.text: Egyptian spirit affected by ammunition shortage to the north

parts.note: ammunition cut short gives the informal word ammo

explanation.surface: An Egyptian deity troubled by a lack of munitions in the north.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected by' and 'to the' are link words; Ammon (Amun) was the chief god of Thebes.
explanation.definitionFit: The ram-headed chief god of Thebes was worshipped in Egypt.

clue.text: Anne disposed to follow one quite silly

indicators.note: to follow says the rearranged name comes after the letter for one

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: disposed means arranged, so the letters of Anne are set out afresh

explanation.surface: Anne is inclined to behave like a fool, according to someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disposed' looks like 'inclined' in the surface, but is the anagram signal; 'to follow' puts the rearranged name after the one.
explanation.definitionFit: Something pointless and foolish is utterly silly.

clue.text: Unable to include a reference which is shocking

indicators.note: to include means the first word holds the second inside it

parts.note: taken as written
a passing reference to something is a mention of it

explanation.surface: Someone cannot cite something because it is too scandalous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to include' means the first word is split to hold the reference; 'which is' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something too shocking to be spoken of in polite company is taboo.

clue.text: Crib player who can take any role?

definitions.text: Crib player who can take any role?

parts.words: Crib player who can take any role?
parts.note: a crib is a baby's cot, suggesting a performer gifted from birth; it also sounds like the card game cribbage

explanation.surface: A cribbage player willing to play any part.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crib' suggests the card game, but it is a baby's cot: a performer talented from the cradle.
explanation.definitionFit: A naturally gifted performer seems to have had the talent from birth.

clue.text: Simple words used to tempt a reluctant customer

definitions.meaning: simple means easy, and words can mean terms

definitions.text: used to tempt a reluctant customer
definitions.meaning: gentle instalment payment arrangements offered by sellers

explanation.surface: Plain language a salesman uses to win over a hesitant buyer.
explanation.definitionFit: Gentle instalment arrangements lure hesitant buyers, and the phrase literally means simple vocabulary.

clue.text: Business head possessed by a younger wife

definitions.meaning: the chief partner in a firm
a younger wife has a husband who is older than her

explanation.surface: A company chief married to someone young.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possessed by' reads as being owned by, but the joke is that a younger wife has an older spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief of a firm is its most senior member, and a younger wife's husband is her elder companion.

clue.text: After a job

definitions.meaning: a prefix meaning after, as in postwar
a position of employment

explanation.surface: Someone seeking employment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'After a job' reads as job-hunting, but splits into two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin prefix meaning later, and a word for an appointment at work, are spelt the same.

clue.text: Took a stance and popped the question

definitions.meaning: struck an attitude, sat for a portrait
asked something, put a question

explanation.surface: A suitor striking an attitude before proposing marriage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'popped the question' suggests proposing marriage, but means simply asked a question.
explanation.definitionFit: Striking an attitude for a portrait, and putting a question forward, share this past tense.

clue.text: Put up with or just put up

definitions.meaning: tolerated, endured
rose to one's feet, got up

explanation.surface: A question of whether something was tolerated or merely raised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or' links the two definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: Endured something, and rose upright on the feet, are both this past tense.

clue.text: Longish note which may be read back

indicators.note: the letters spell the same word whether read forwards or backwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A fairly lengthy message that can be reread.
explanation.walkthrough: The note is musical: a half note, twice a crotchet.
explanation.definitionFit: In music, a half note lasts two beats, fairly long.

clue.text: Lure a sailor back with sex appeal

indicators.note: back tells us the sailor's letters are read in reverse

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor
IT is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Tempting a seaman home with charm.
explanation.definitionFit: Something put out to tempt prey or a victim is an enticement.

clue.text: Work on the Twelve to form an oil cartel

parts.note: op, short for opus, is a musical work
the European Community, which had twelve member states when this puzzle was set

explanation.surface: Getting the European nations to set up an oil group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' and 'to form' are link words. 'the Twelve' suggests the apostles, but means the then twelve-nation European Community.
explanation.definitionFit: The Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries is the best-known oil producers' cartel.

clue.text: Man needing record assistance

parts.note: he is a male person
an LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A man who needs a hand with a record.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needing' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Aid given to someone is assistance.

clue.text: Don't display everything-just the finest example

definitions.meaning: show only a part, read as two words
the best item in a collection

explanation.surface: Advice to show off only the best item.
explanation.walkthrough: Split, the first reading is an instruction: show a single part, not the whole.
explanation.definitionFit: The star exhibit is the outstanding example, and the words also say exhibit a portion.

clue.text: Trees pulped to obtain fragrant oil

indicators.note: pulped means mashed up, so the letters of trees are rearranged

explanation.surface: Wood is mashed to extract a scented oil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to obtain' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: This organic compound gives many fruits and perfumes their scent.

clue.text: Logical outcome of taking off

definitions.meaning: a conclusion reasoned from evidence
subtracting an amount, such as from pay

explanation.surface: The reasoned result of an aircraft's departure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking off' suggests flight, but means subtracting.
explanation.definitionFit: A reasoned conclusion and a subtraction from a total share this word.

clue.text: City which captivated Helen

definitions.meaning: the capital of France
the Trojan prince who carried off Helen of Sparta

explanation.surface: A town that charmed a woman called Helen.
explanation.definitionFit: The French capital shares its name with the Trojan prince who eloped with Helen.
